title: おとろしないで、おいなりさん

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a day out together, Tamamo Cross and I wander the area by the academy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Psst, psst! C'mon, there's nothin' to be scared of!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: There ya go. Who's a good girl? Sorry to come encroaching on your space, gorgeous…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yelp!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Ouuuch! You really latched on there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You in the middle of a one-person skit or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey guys! Good timin'. Take a peek down into this ditch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We follow Inari One's gaze down into the crevice to find…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, there's a fox in here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, poor gal's gotten herself tangled up in a net.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: She's real antsy. Whenever I try to pull her out, she bites me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wow, she's all muddied up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I don't got it in me to leave her in there… What should we do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: First, let's try and calm her down.
Let's go down into the ditch and free her from the net!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Good plan. How 'bout we feed her somethin'? Seein' as we just went to the grocery store and all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Somethin' a fox can eat… Somethin' a fox can eat…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Here ya go, I got some tasty beans for ya.

text_block_list.name: Fox
text_block_list.text: Grr…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, she's lookin' at 'em! They're not poisonous, c'monnn, give 'em a nibble.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fox cranes her neck out, but then, the very moment she gobbles up the beans—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwoosh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Huh? She vanished into thin air!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute. There's somethin' there, right where the fox was…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It's a stopwatch! And it's pretty fancy-lookin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Is this her way of sayin' thanks? Ahaha, how cute!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wow, life sure can take ya by surprise sometimes… Hey, Trainer. How 'bout we use this?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, guess we gotta, huh. But if there's one thing I got, it's guts.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Look, I'm here to save your fluffy li'l tush, so don't go squirmin' now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Leaping into the ditch, Tamamo Cross lifts the net off. But the very moment she yanks it away—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bright light envelops my vision…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the?! Why's it so dark out?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Tama, check it out… There's a gorgeous gal standing right over there.
I thank you…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: W-we're back! What the heck just happened?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And what's up with that drink in your hand?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're right! How'd that get there?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Mm. Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You're actually drinkin' it?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Between this 'n the mysterious lady sayin' thanks, I'll guess it's a token of the fox's appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Life sure can take ya by surprise…
